data.name: Midhun
data.gender_notes: Midhun is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word 'Mithuna', meaning 'Sun'. In Hindu mythology, Mithuna is the name of the zodiac sign Taurus and one of the Navagrahas (nine celestial beings). The name is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and success. The name Midhun carries the meaning “Sun God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Midhun usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the power and energy of the Sun.
data.etymology: Midhun belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Midhun total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Midhun holds great significance in Hindu culture, particularly in the context of astrology. In Hindu astrology, Taurus is the second sign of the Zodiac and is ruled by Venus. Midhun is the name of the Navagraha associated with Taurus, making it an essential element of this sign. The popularity of the use of the name Midhun can be traced to the strong connection it has with these cultural traditions, particularly in the Indian subcontinent.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Midhun holds significance in Hindu traditions as a representation of the Sun. In Hinduism, the Sun is considered a powerful deity and is often associated with light, energy, and creativity. Being named Midhun carries with it the blessings of this divine celestial body, and is believed to bring prosperity, wealth, and success in one's endeavors. This spiritual significance is deeply embedded in Hindu beliefs and adds an enriching dimension to the name Midhun.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Midhun, in Hinduism, symbolizes the radiant and dynamic aspect of the Sun God. The name is derived from 'Mithuna,' the zodiac sign representing the union of Shiva and Shakti, signifying harmony, love, and creativity.

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that The name Midhun is mentioned in the Mahabharata as a hero of the Pandavas. The name Midhun carried significant spiritual weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Midhun is associated with bravery and heroism in Hindu mythology.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Midhun remains relevant in modern Hindu society, representing a bridge between traditional Vedic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Hindu names.

name_in_real_life.story: Anita Midhun from Kolkata, India embodies the meaning of Midhun - "Sun God". Growing up in a Hindu family, they were taught to honor the spiritual significance of their name and live according to dharma.
